# Hook environment incident and full-suite limit

This note is read-only forensic evidence, not a runtime repair. No interpreter
or dependency install command was explicitly issued by this child agent, and
no interpreter files were edited. That is not a claim that installation did
not occur: filesystem evidence shows a new managed interpreter and hook
environment actually appeared while the full suite was running.

## Exact command issued

Working directory C:\GitHub\distillr, PowerShell. The verification tool call
first ran a standard-library artifact validation through `uv run --frozen
python -c ...`, then this literal PowerShell command text:

```powershell
$repairArtifactPaths = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'docs/research/evidence/2026-10-25/issues-61-67-repair-trial' -File -Recurse | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); uv run --frozen pre-commit run trailing-whitespace --files $repairArtifactPaths; uv run --frozen pre-commit run end-of-file-fixer --files $repairArtifactPaths; uv run --frozen pre-commit run mixed-line-ending --files $repairArtifactPaths; git diff --check -- docs ROADMAP.md
```

The first hook announced:

```text
[INFO] Installing environment for https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks.
[INFO] Once installed this environment will be reused.
[INFO] This may take a few minutes...
```

The running tool session was 20296. No hook pass was returned before stopping.
The tool wrapper yielded after ten seconds, and this child agent next inspected
the process table. No intentional `uv python install`, `uv sync`, `pip install`,
`pre-commit install`, or environment variable modification accompanied this
verification. However `uv run --frozen` and pre-commit can perform environment
setup; neither `--offline` nor `--no-python-downloads` was supplied. Frozen
dependency resolution is not an interpreter-download prohibition.

The invocation resolves uv to
`C:\Users\nicks\AppData\Local\hermes\bin\uv.exe`.
Environment inspection afterward found no UV_* or PRE_COMMIT_* overrides.
USERPROFILE=C:\Users\nicks; LOCALAPPDATA=C:\Users\nicks\AppData\Local;
HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and PRE_COMMIT_HOME were unset. `.python-version` is 3.15.
The repo .venv/pyvenv.cfg points at the generic managed 3.15 path, records uv
0.13.1 and version_info3.15. The actual uv executable version was not probed.

## Processes stopped

The snapshot showed PowerShell PID72684 (parent46252) running this tool batch,
and uv PID55496 (parent72684) running the trailing-whitespace command. Their
PowerShell-formatted command lines were truncated in the captured output; no
complete nested installer process command was retained. A later read-only
inspection process74024 was unrelated and was not selected for termination.

The stop script enumerated Win32_Process once, built descendants of72684 by
ParentProcessId, then called Stop-Process on only that identified tree. It
reported that the tree stopped. This prevents intentionally proceeding to the
later two hook calls, but does not roll back any installation already completed
or guarantee child installers had not already exited. No cache cleanup or
runtime rollback was attempted. No pre-commit.log was found at the default
cache root when inspected.

## Actual filesystem evidence

Read-only inspection found:

- Managed generic interpreter path
  C:\Users\nicks\AppData\Roaming\uv\python\cpython-3.15-windows-x86_64-none
  is a junction pointing to cpython-3.15.1-windows-x86_64-none. Its creation and
  modification timestamps are2026-10-26T01:20:42Z.
- The3.15.1 directory appeared at the same time. Its
  Lib/xml/dom/minidom.py has creation/mtime2026-10-26T01:20:41Z and68574bytes.
  Parent measured exact mtime01:20:41.615Z. An older separate3.15.0 directory
  still exists. This is consistent with replacement of the generic target,
  not necessarily an in-place source edit of the old interpreter.
- C:\Users\nicks\.cache\pre-commit\repop8k_30a3\py_env-python3.15
  changed at01:21:49Z. Its pyvenv.cfg records version3.15.1.final.0 and:
  `command = C:\GitHub\distillr\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m virtualenv C:\Users\nicks\.cache\pre-commit\repop8k_30a3\py_env-python3.15`.
  It records virtualenv21.14.13 and the same generic base-prefix junction.
  The pre_commit_hooks.egg-info directory changed at01:21:47Z.

These observations establish actual environment setup, despite the attempted
stop. They do not by themselves identify which process downloaded/extracted
3.15.1 or whether my uv invocation initiated that earlier change. No installer
audit log or complete child chain was captured. Automatic uv setup is possible;
concurrent external work is also not excluded. Do not claim definitive causal
attribution from timestamps alone, and do not claim no installation occurred.

## Impact on verification

Parent reports full suite8100passed/1failed: pypdf import failed because
xml.dom.minidom lacked `_XML_WHITESPACE`, which expatbuilder required. The
focused test passed afterward and the symbol now exists. The runtime-path
change during the suite is a plausible explanation for inconsistent standard
library imports, not a proven repository-code regression or proven cause of
that exact missing symbol. Do not hide the full-suite failure, patch pypdf,
weaken the assertion or treat the focused pass as full acceptance.

Once the environment is stable, parent should pin/record the actual interpreter
executable identity/version and repeat the complete gate without concurrent
uv/pre-commit environment setup. Current status is not green. This child
performed only read-only filesystem/process inspection plus this scratch note;
no runtime repair or further setup was attempted in response to the incident.
